items.title: OpenClaw Partners with VirusTotal to Secure AI Agent Skill Marketplace

items.title: BeyondTrust Remote Access Products 0-Day Vulnerability Allows Remote Code Execution
items.description: BeyondTrust has disclosed a critical pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability affecting its Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA) platforms, potentially exposing thousands of organizations to system compromise. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-1731 and classified under CWE-78 (OS Command Injection), enables attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands…

items.title: nmapUnleashed Makes Nmap Scanning More Comfortable and Effective
